global_style: A modern, minimalist presentation template featuring bold blue geometric crops, ample whitespace, and asymmetrical layouts ideal for portfolios or creative agencies.

identity_anchors: Oversized, cropped blue geometric shapes (circles, rings, semi-circles) anchoring slide edges and corners.
Asymmetrical, modular layouts balancing large rectangular image blocks with generous negative space.
Stark contrast between heavy, bold headers and light, small body copy.
Complete absence of gradients, shadows, or 3D effects, maintaining a strictly flat design language.

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
